# Workforce Next

> Workforce Next is an IT consulting and IT services company based in India that offers remote developers and QA engineers for startups to enterprises. Hire on a dedicated, fractional, or full-time basis, with flexible hours and flexible timezone coverage shaped to your team. Engineers plug straight into your engineering, product, and consulting functions and ship software for you. People are matched by industry context and longevity signals using SethAI, an AI-powered recruiter. Headquartered in DLF Cyber City, Gurugram with a tech office in Noida.

## What Workforce Next Does

Workforce Next offers remote developers and QA engineers from India who work on your product on dedicated, fractional, or full-time engagements. Engineers can work standard India hours or shift their schedule to overlap with US, UK, EU, Canada, Australia, or Dubai working hours. Unlike traditional staffing that matches on tech stack alone, Workforce Next uses context-first matching: a Java developer who built banking systems is matched to fintech clients, not just any Java project.

## Developer Specialisms

- AI & Agentic Developers: LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, RAG pipelines, multi-agent systems
- Data Engineers: dbt, Spark, Airflow, Snowflake, data lakehouses
- Frontend Engineers: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- Backend Engineers: FastAPI, Node.js, Go, PostgreSQL, microservices
- Product Engineers: Full-stack engineers matched by industry context (fintech, logistics, healthtech, SaaS)
- Vibe-Code Optimisation Engineers: Review and productionise AI-generated code from Cursor and Copilot
- Cloud Cost Optimisation Engineers: FinOps, AWS/Azure/GCP rightsizing, Kubernetes cost reduction
- QA Engineers & Testers: Manual, automation, performance, security, and API testing
- LangChain Developers, RAG Pipeline Developers, FastAPI Developers

## Engagement Models

- MVP Sprint: 1 senior developer, 4 weeks, fixed price (INR 1.2-1.8L / $1,500-$2,200). For founders building their first AI product.
- Engineering Pod: 3-8 dedicated developers, 48-hour matching. For funded startups scaling their product team.
- Enterprise Consulting: Expert on-demand, staff augmentation, or fixed-scope projects. Free 2-hour architecture assessment.

## Key Differentiators

- SethAI: AI recruiter that screens for technical skills AND longevity signals (ownership mindset, career alignment, communication reliability). Generates a 1-page match report per candidate.
- Context-First Matching: Developers matched by industry experience and product type, not just programming language.
- Context Continuity Guarantee: If a developer leaves, documentation (codebase walkthrough, domain glossary, architecture decisions) enables replacement to be productive in days.
- Monthly Engineering Advisory: Proactive check-in asking what the team needs in the next 90 days.
- 48-hour matching, 1-week paid trial, zero recruitment fees.

## Products

- SethAI Recruiter: AI-powered developer matching and screening engine (currently in development, waitlist open)
